summary: Lufax Holding Ltd filed a routine Form 6-K (the US equivalent of a foreign private issuer's current report) announcing, via an Exhibit 99.1 Hong Kong Exchange announcement, that its board will meet on October 27, 2026 to consider and approve unaudited quarterly financial results for the nine months ended September 30, 2026 and their publication. No transaction, stake, price, premium, advisor, or structural term is disclosed. This is a routine board-meeting scheduling notice, not a special situation. Watch only for the results release and any ensuing earnings-driven trading.
